svg.title: preflight.sh
svg.desc: Example preflight output on a full 1TB machine: 2.5G free, load 287, 17G of swap, booted simulators and a staged OS update.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
text.tspan: Below 20G or 10%: builds, simulators and swap start failing.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
text.tspan: Processes are stalled (usually on disk I/O from swapping).

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
text.tspan: Swap files live on the same disk. Close sims/emulators/daemons.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
text.tspan: xcrun simctl shutdown all (keeps their data).

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
text.tspan: Close emulators you are not using.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
text.tspan: A macOS update is staged. Its snapshots pin deleted blocks.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
text.tspan: Resolve memory and snapshot warnings first: deleting files

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace
text.tspan: will not stop swap from refilling the disk.
